notes:
Bounded discovery pass on 2026-09-24: used 5 of 6 allowed web searches and opened ~8 of 12 allowed posting pages. Verified 5 active, US-located, entry-appropriate postings from employer ATS pages (Greenhouse/Ashby) matched against seen_jobs and previously_delivered (no overlap; Snowflake/Databricks not re-proposed). Coverage prioritized cap-exempt and preferred employer types: direct Greenhouse/Ashby board APIs were probed for ~60 cap-exempt research institutes, universities, hospitals, medical-device, streaming-data and test-automation employers. Only one cap-exempt employer (Chan Zuckerberg Biohub, nonprofit research) had a live fitting role; Arc Institute, CZI, Flatiron Health, Komodo Health, Natera, Grafana Labs, MotherDuck, Feldera, Materialize and others had no qualifying entry-level US roles this pass. Note: Workday-hosted boards (most universities, hospitals, national labs) were unreachable from this network (DNS failures), so cap-exempt coverage is partial and a follow-up pass via a different route is recommended. No posting contained visa-sponsorship, citizenship, clearance or ITAR wording, so restriction_quote is empty and sponsorship_state is unknown for all five; one posting (Sigma New Grad SWE) explicitly refused sponsorship and was excluded with its sentence. Employee size bounds were not independently verifiable from sources accessed, so employee_min/max are left null rather than invented.

Wanted 2 startup companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and low-competition checks.
Wanted 1 mid-sized company, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.
Wanted 2 large companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.
